description: Plan multi-city round trips from real-world travel data. Discover the most-visited cities in a country or region, build a route stop by stop, and open the finished trip on an interactive map in the Plan Your Trip planner — where you can adjust stops and nights and get cost and hotel estimates. No account needed.
